abstract: BACKGROUND: Ovarian dermoid cysts are common benign neoplasms that typically manifest as a solitary lesion. Bilateral multifocal presentations, particularly in the context of polycystic ovarian syndrome (PCOS), are exceptionally rare and pose significant diagnostic challenges. CASE PRESENTATION: A 22-year-old nulligravid Caucasian woman with a history of PCOS presented with acute, severe lower abdominal pain accompanied by nausea and vomiting. Initial imaging revealed large bilateral ovarian masses with features consistent with dermoid cysts and clinical findings suggestive of a right ovarian torsion. Despite a prior computed tomography (CT) scan indicating bilateral ovarian cysts, the patient attributed her symptoms to PCOS-related changes, delaying timely evaluation. Intraoperative findings during an exploratory laparotomy confirmed the presence of more than five distinct dermoid teratomas on each ovary. Bilateral ovarian cystectomies were performed with careful preservation of ovarian stromal tissue, and histopathological analysis verified the diagnosis of mature cystic teratomas. CONCLUSION: This case underscores the critical need for early differentiation between PCOS-related cysts and ovarian dermoid cysts to avert complications such as ovarian torsion and to preserve fertility. It also highlights the essential role of clear and effective communication between healthcare providers and patients in ensuring timely diagnosis and intervention. Misinterpretation of clinical symptoms can lead to delayed presentation with potentially deleterious effects on future fertility. TEACHING POINT: A CT scan obtained during the patient's initial evaluation revealed ovarian teratomas; however, the patient mistakenly believed these masses represented her typical PCOS-associated cysts rather than pathology of a different etiology. This misconception delayed recognition of the severity of her condition and underscores the importance of clear physician-patient communication to ensure patients understand the significance of their diagnoses, particularly when fertility and overall well-being may be affected.
abstract_ja: 背景：卵巣類皮嚢腫は一般的な良性腫瘍であり、通常は単発性病変として現れる。両側多発性の表現型は、特に多嚢胞性卵巣症候群(PCOS)を背景とする場合、きわめてまれで、診断上大きな課題を伴う。症例提示：PCOSの既往を持つ22歳の未経妊のコーカソイド女性が、急性の強い下腹部痛と悪心・嘔吐を訴えて来院した。初期画像検査では、類皮嚢腫と一致する大きな両側卵巣腫瘤と、右卵巣捻転を示唆する臨床所見が認められた。以前に実施されたCTで両側卵巣嚢胞が示されていたにもかかわらず、患者は自身の症状をPCOSに伴う変化と捉え、評価が遅れた。開腹術中の所見で、両側卵巣にそれぞれ5個を超える個別の奇形腫が確認された。両側卵巣嚢腫切除術を行い、卵巣間質組織を慎重に温存した。病理組織学的検査で成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確定した。結論：本症例は、卵巣捻転などの合併症を防ぎ、妊孕性を温存するため、PCOS関連嚢胞と卵巣類皮嚢腫を早期に鑑別することの重要性を示している。また、適切な診断と介入を確実に行うため、医療者と患者の間で明確で効果的なコミュニケーションを取ることの重要性も浮き彫りになった。診断の誤解は受診の遅れを生じさせ、将来の妊孕性に有害な影響を与えうる。教育的ポイント：初期評価のCTで卵巣奇形腫が示されていたが、患者はそれを典型的なPCOS関連嚢胞と誤認し、病態の重大さの認識が遅れた。この誤解は、妊孕性や全身の健康に影響しうる場合に、医師と患者の明確なコミュニケーションが重要であることを物語っている。
